title: mruby 4.0.0-rc2 cross-built for CheriBSD purecap, the release corpus's fourth arm
workload: the 23 cases of the release corpus, plus its own controls: the interpreter evaluates, and 40- and 500-frame recursion survives revocation
note: Not a port of an allocator: mruby's own allocators are unchanged here. The point is the comparison -- the same defects under CheriBSD's deployed heap revocation instead of ours.
